channel.title: CHUM — A Tribute to Phish (News & Shows)
channel.description: Official news, band updates, and Northern California show announcements from Chum, the San Francisco Bay Area Phish tribute band active since 2010.

item.title: Featured in Surrender to the Flow (Dick's 2026 Issue): Phish Tributes
item.description: Chum is profiled in Sydne Kasle's national Phish tribute feature in Surrender to the Flow alongside Pink Talking Fish, The Last Rewind, and Kids Under the Carpet.

item.title: On AI Art and Posters
item.description: We've seen some comments about our use of AI-generated art for show posters, and we wanted to respond as thoughtfully as possible.

item.title: Miss You — Remembering John Greene
item.description: Remembering our dear brother John Greene (2014–2025), keyboardist and vocalist for Chum.
